shots.wide: Subject(s) small in frame with lots of set around them.
shots.two-shot: Two (or more) subjects together, head to waist.
shots.over-shoulder: Over `over` actor's shoulder onto the subject.
shots.insert: Detail of a set item (`item` + optional `anchor`, e.g. a monitor's "screen").

moves.push-in: Moves toward the aim point (amount = fraction of distance, default 0.22).
moves.orbit: Circles the aim point (amount = degrees, default 30).
moves.life: Barely visible breathing camera: slow push + drift (amount = intensity, default 1). Opt-in.

notes.angle: degrees around the subject from its facing (0 = frontal, + = toward its left). Authored angles are never auto-corrected.
notes.height: eye | low | high | metres relative to eye level
notes.lens: focal length in mm on the image's short side (default per shot); or `fov` (vertical degrees)
notes.track: aim follows the subject (camera body stays); { lag } seconds of smoothing
notes.follow: camera body follows the subject too; { lag }
notes.lock: true = no automatic corrections at all
notes.allowOcclusion: ids allowed to block the view (deliberate foreground)
notes.blend: seconds to blend from the previous shot instead of cutting
notes.allow: findings in this shot that are deliberate, e.g. ["offscreen"] (catalog/direction.json intents)
